units.source_text: 岛村是把她一个人单独来看的，凭她那种举止就推断她可能是个姑娘。

en.t: Shimamura had come to see her as someone set apart, and from that manner of hers he concluded that she was probably a young woman.

units.source_text: 也许是因为他用过分好奇的目光盯住这个姑娘，所以增添了自己不少的感伤。

en.t: Perhaps because he had stared at the young woman with an excessively curious gaze, he had added quite a bit of his own sentimentality.
